The suite grew from 86 to 96 checks, including the two-enemy acceptance case ([3,6] hits, hero HP 91), single-hit consumption, unused expiry, re-guard, minimum damage and boss interaction. The validator-owned guard_contract.gd passes unmodified (exit 0), so the regression was not rewritten to fit the code.
